title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4GRID - GetOperationObjectOutput
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4grid/GetOperationObjectOutput. This class specifies that the output of a get operation is going to be a class. Subclass of SAREF4GRID's own GetOperationOutput.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'GetOperationObjectOutput'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

hasOutputObjectType.description: Property. It identifies the type (class) of the output. The value of this property conforms to the range of an object property of SAREF4GRID.
